resources.name: Censys Universal Internet Dataset
quotes: IP addresses that previously hosted services that were indexed by Shodan [69] or Censys [32] attract a significantly different set of scanners
we investigate how attackers use the most-frequently scanning Internet service search engines [53]—Censys [32] and Shodan [69]
Researchers can use search engines (e.g., Censys [32] and Shodan [69]) to obtain a history of an IP address.
